purpose: The wave-code vocabulary M49.G1 enforces over validation/m49/ledger.json. It lives here, as data, because the ledger is an append-only record written by whichever agent closes a review wave: a vocabulary hardcoded inside the gate drifts the moment a wave appends a legitimate code, and the drift shows up as G1 failing on a row no rule forbade (CPP1/RS1/GO1/CS1/Z1 at W13; RB1 at W14). The gate keeps its full strictness — a code outside this registry still fails — and now additionally requires every reviews/ language directory to either own a code or be listed under `unwaved` with a reason, so the next wave must register itself instead of tripping an invisible list.

unwaved.convergence: Cross-language convergence sweep (M49.CONV) — its findings land as waves, not as a per-language ledger row.
unwaved.java: Java's review waves are registered in script/m14/spec/java-completeness.json (JD codes) plus the onboarding board; the M49 ledger carries no java row, because J2/J4/J5/J6 are JAVASCRIPT (J = javascript above). Recorded here rather than left silent, so the gap is visible in the gate output.
unwaved.svelte: Svelte's waves (Sv1/Sv2, M49.W4) close through the web-family folder; no per-language M49 ledger row exists.
unwaved.systems-family: Family-level roll-up (closure report + onboarding rows), not a per-language wave.
unwaved.web-family: Family-level roll-up (closure report + onboarding rows), not a per-language wave.
